quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #17
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: Which statement about railroad crossings is true?

options.text: It is illegal to drive around lowered gates at a crossing.
You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger tells you to.
Not all railroad crossings have flashing red lights and gates.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: You must stop when a flagger, stop sign, or warning devices like gates or flashing lights tell you to. Not all crossings have these devices. It is illegal to drive around lowered railroad gates.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone
Only when driving in rural areas
When driving in bad weather

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you block the normal flow of traffic. You can get a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: Drivers cannot pass from either side of a ____ centerline.

options.text: Solid and broken yellow combination
Single broken yellow
Double solid yellow
Single broken white

questions.explanation: A double solid yellow line in the center of a two-way road means traffic from both directions cannot cross it to pass.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: Signal at least 100 feet before changing lanes to pass. Make sure there is no oncoming traffic.
Use your mirrors and look over your left shoulder to check your blind spot when passing left.
When passing, wait until you see both headlights of the other car in your rearview mirror before moving back to your lane.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Always signal at least 100 feet before you change lanes to pass. Check your mirrors and look over your shoulder for your blind spot. Wait until you see both headlights of the other car in your rearview mirror before moving back to your lane.

questions.question: You are in the right lane of a highway and want to move to the left lane. You should:

options.text: Look in your rearview mirror for traffic behind you.
Look over your left shoulder for traffic in your blind spot.
Look in your side mirror for traffic and turn on your signal.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move. Make sure no other vehicles are in that lane. Always signal when you change lanes.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: U-turns are not allowed.
U-turns are allowed.
Winding road ahead.
Sharp left turn ahead.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Use alternate routes.
Drive the same way you drive on dry roads.
Increase the distance between you and the car ahead.
Avoid crossing bridges or intersections.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase the distance between you and the car ahead.
questions.explanation: On slippery roads, increase the distance between you and the car ahead. Your car will take longer to stop than it does on dry roads.

questions.question: To safely drive after drinking alcohol, you should:

options.text: Wait for a period of time.
Drink black coffee or another drink with caffeine.
Take a cold shower.
None of these.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a period of time.
questions.explanation: You cannot speed up how fast alcohol leaves your body. Black coffee, fresh air, food, or a cold shower might help you stay awake, but they will not sober you up. Only time removes the effects of alcohol.

questions.question: You cannot pass safely on a two-way, two-lane street unless:

options.text: You can clearly see the road ahead.
You can return to your lane before meeting oncoming traffic.
Your vehicle can go fast enough to pass.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: You cannot pass safely on a two-way, two-lane street unless you can see the road clearly, you can return to your lane before meeting oncoming traffic, and your vehicle can go fast enough to pass. Do not pass where it is illegal or unsafe.

questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only alcohol levels above the legal limit can
Alcohol does not
Even a small amount of alcohol can
Only alcohol levels above 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even a small amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol reduces your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory. Your driving skills will suffer. No one can drink and drive safely.

questions.question: How can you avoid hitting vehicles in your blind spots?

options.text: Turn your head to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
Adjust your rearview mirrors every few minutes.
Honk your horn right before turning or changing lanes.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Before turning or changing lanes, turn your head and look over your shoulder to see if your blind spot is clear. Do not rely only on your mirrors.

questions.question: When can you drive around a lowering railroad crossing gate?

options.text: Never.
If the gate is broken.
If you have time to cross before the gate closes.
If there is a shoulder to the right of the gate.

questions.explanation: If the gates are down at a railroad crossing, stay still. Do not try to cross until the gates are raised. It is illegal to drive around railroad crossing gates.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and other traffic.
Slow down without stopping completely.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and other traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before going.

questions.question: Where is it illegal to pass another vehicle?

options.text: On hills and curves.
At intersections.
At railroad crossings.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: You cannot pass on hills, curves, intersections, or railroad crossings. These locations are unsafe for passing.

questions.question: You are on a narrow road and meet an oncoming vehicle. What must you do?

options.text: Pull completely off the road and stop.
Give the other vehicle at least half of the road.
Tell the other vehicle to pull over.
Turn on your high beams so they see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the other vehicle at least half of the road.
questions.explanation: On narrow roads, you must give oncoming vehicles at least half of the road space. Both drivers need enough room to pass safely.

questions.question: You miss your destination while driving in heavy city traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Stop where you are.
Back up to where you should have stopped.
Make a U-turn.
Drive around the block.

questions.explanation: If you pass your destination in heavy traffic, circle the block to return. Never make a U-turn in heavy traffic.

questions.question: Your car breaks down on a highway. What should you do?

options.text: Stay in your car and wait for help.
Turn on your hazard flashers to warn other drivers.
Honk your horn at passing cars.
Flash your headlights at oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your hazard flashers to warn other drivers.
questions.explanation: If your car breaks down on the highway, turn on your hazard flashers. Exit the road safely and get as far off the road as possible. Lift your hood so other drivers know your car is disabled.

questions.question: How do you stay safe while driving in poor weather?

options.text: Keep a greater distance from the car ahead.
Do not drive on worn tires.
Slow down.
All of these.

questions.explanation: Worn tires do not grip wet roads well. Drive with good tires at a safe distance from other cars and at a reduced speed in bad weather.

questions.question: When a green light turns on, what should you do?

options.text: Let pedestrians cross first.
Speed up as fast as you can.
Back up slowly.
Wait until another driver waves you on.

questions.explanation: A green light means you can go. However, you must first let pedestrians and other traffic clear the intersection.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow line on your side of the road mean?

options.text: Slow down.
Pass with caution.
Do not pass.
Keep right on hills.

questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass other vehicles from your direction.
